title: Recursive value of a game position
statement: Given a Boolean-valued winning condition $W$ on finite Boolean histories, define the value at a position $h$ with zero remaining steps to be $W(h)$. With $r+1$ steps remaining, take the logical disjunction of the values at the two one-bit extensions of $h$ when $h$ has even length, and their logical conjunction when $h$ has odd length.
hypotheses_covered: A Boolean-valued winning condition on finite Boolean histories
A natural number of remaining steps
